codeReview.summary: DIAG-003 is a comprehensive and well-structured analysis of mm_retain/mm_release reference counting patterns across the iSH kernel codebase. The worker correctly analyzed all 5 relevant source files (mmap.c, init.c, fork.c, exec.c, exit.c) and produced a thorough 313-line documentation file.

findingsDetailed.details: All mm_retain/mm_release call sites were reviewed: mmap.c (mm_new, mm_copy, mm_retain, mm_release), init.c (construct_task), fork.c (copy_task CLONE_VM and non-CLONE_VM paths), exec.c (elf_exec), and exit.c (do_exit).

The analysis correctly identified the exec window vulnerability (mm_release before task_set_mm) that was the root cause of the NULL current->mem crash. The worker also correctly self-corrected an initial false positive about fork.c error path reference counting.
The reference counting pattern summary table provides a clear overview of all lifecycle operations with safety ratings. This will be valuable for future maintenance.
The recommended fix (setting current->mm = NULL before mm_release) was implemented in FIX-001 and verified to resolve the issue.
